Consequential scientific roles do not erase an independently applicable responsibility, but uncertainty alone establishes neither universal standing nor whole-root necessity. No new operating witness or scientific rerun is claimed.

naturalistic_patient_good_follow_up.evidence: An idealized assessment must preserve the actual patient and circumstances. A finite absorbing counterexample shows that all designated facts can be acquired while recommendations remain order-dependent. This is not a fully rational ideal-agent countermodel or a disproof of naturalistic reduction. Joint empirical and evaluative identification remains a positive route from natural patient conditions to warranted good. Personal good, moral obligation and categorical actor-addressed reasons remain distinct; plural good alternatives are allowed. Recipient-action evidence is read only at its existing canonical scope. Whole-root necessity remains open.
